title: prep validate result, version 1
description: What 'python3 -m tools.prep validate --json OUT' writes (tools/prep/README.md, 'prep validate'). 'passed' is true only when every check has status 'pass'. The checks, their order and their failure codes are listed in the README. 'prep report' re-runs the validator and treats a stored result as a record of history, not as authority.
$comment: Patterns end in $(?!\n) for the reason given in checkpoints.schema.json.

epubcheck_version.description: null when EPUBCheck did not run

created.description: UTC time of the run: --timestamp, else $SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, else the clock.

draft.description: The draft whose exclusions the coverage check used, or null.

coverage_mode.description: 'draft': exclusions come from the draft. 'implicit': no draft; a spine document without a section counts as excluded. null when coverage could not run.

checks.description: 13 checks; a result written by tools.prep 1.0.0 (before the exclusions check) has 12, and stays a valid record.

file.description: The file name, without its directory.

sha256.description: null when the file could not be read.

status.description: pass; fail (failures are listed); incomplete (no failure found, but part of the book could not be judged because an earlier check failed); not-run (the check could not run at all). Only pass is a pass.
